description: Create the Fixed Income question data file with modules M1-M5 (48 questions total)
steps: M1: Fixed-Income Instrument Features (11 Qs) - bond features, par value, coupon, maturity, indenture, covenants, embedded options
M2: Fixed-Income Cash Flows and Types (16 Qs) - bullet, amortizing, sinking fund, FRN, step-up, PIK, deferred, index-linked
M3: Fixed-Income Issuance and Trading (6 Qs) - primary/secondary markets, private placement, shelf registration, settlement
M4: Fixed-Income Markets for Corporate Issuers (7 Qs) - secured/unsecured bonds, MTN, commercial paper, green bonds
M5: Fixed-Income Markets for Government Issuers (8 Qs) - T-bills, T-notes, T-bonds, TIPS, sovereign, agency, muni
acceptance_criteria: File exists with M1=11, M2=16, M3=6, M4=7, M5=8 questions
All questions use real CFA Fixed Income content
